title: Install bar date locators before shared-subplot label hiding
answers: Why do date labels appear on every shared-x bar subplot?
How should bar plots hide inner subplot date labels?
When should BarPlot install dynamic date locators?
body:
Symptom: Bar subplots with a regular-frequency date index show minor date labels on inner shared-x axes instead of only the bottom subplot.
Root cause: Installing dynamic date locators in pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._post_plot_logic happens after _adorn_subplots hides shared-x labels, allowing the new locators to redraw them.
Fix pattern: Install the period converter and dynamic date locators in pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._setup_date_axis, before subplot adornment; this also ensures user-supplied xticks are mapped through the intended converter.
Constraints: Applies to dynamic date axes for regular-frequency DatetimeIndex/PeriodIndex bar plots; shared-x label hiding requires this ordering, while ordinary positional bar ticks are outside this pattern.
applies: Matplotlib bar plots using dynamic date axes, especially shared-x subplots and user-supplied date ticks.
